title: No regression coverage for embeddings health route behavior
reasoning: The reviewed feature exposes GET /api/embeddings/health, but the feature metadata includes no linked tests. This route has observable API behavior for at least healthy, missing-provider, and dependency-error cases, and those behaviors can drift if dependency resolution or health payload formatting changes.
recommendation: Add focused FastAPI route tests for GET /api/embeddings/health covering a resolved embedding provider, no configured provider, and an exception raised while resolving or building the health payload.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The provided feature context lists no tests, and no included test evidence exercises this route.
suggestedRegressionTest: Use a FastAPI TestClient with dependency overrides for ContainerDep to provide containers with an embedding router, without an embedding router/provider, and with a resolver/payload path that raises; assert status codes and response payload shape for each case.
minimumFixScope: Add focused backend route tests for backend/src/api/routes/memory/embeddings/router.py health_check without changing route behavior.
